title: User guide 3: Make the video
bullets: Start the video from an approved version
Upload the narration made in Google Colab
Follow the progress, watch and download
subtitle: User guide 3: Make the video
narration: Welcome to user guide three. This guide shows how to make the video from an approved language version, how to follow its progress, and how to watch and download the result.

subtitle: Choose voice, quality, subtitles, then Generate video
narration: Open an approved language version and scroll to step five, Make the video. Choose the voice option, the slide style, which is animated by default, the quality, and whether you want subtitles, then click Generate video. Only approved content can be sent, and only one video at a time is made for each language version.

subtitle: Colab voice: download, run the notebook, upload
narration: With the Google Colab voice, the video waits for the narration audio. First, download the narration file. Second, open the Colab notebook, upload that file and run it. It gives you a ZIP with one audio file per slide. Third, choose that ZIP here and click Upload narration. If the ZIP has a problem, the app tells you what is missing and keeps waiting.

subtitle: Waiting in the queue
narration: After the upload, the video joins the queue. The page updates by itself, so you do not need to refresh.

subtitle: The progress bar shows how far along it is
narration: While the video is made, a progress bar shows how far along it is. You can leave this page. The video keeps being made, and the status is still here when you come back.

subtitle: Ready: watch it, then Download MP4
narration: When the status says Ready, the video plays right on the page. Click Download MP4 to save it. The list below also offers the supporting files. The video is kept, so you can download it again later.

title: If something goes wrong
bullets: The message says what happened in plain words
Try again repeats the step safely, no duplicate video is made
Cancel stops a video that is not finished
Make the video again after you change the content
subtitle: If something goes wrong
narration: If something goes wrong, the message says what happened. Click Try again when it is offered. It is safe, because the same request never creates a second video. You can cancel a video that is not finished. If you change and re-approve the content, use Make the video again.

title: Remember
bullets: Colab voice needs your audio upload
The video stays available for download
subtitle: Remember
narration: Remember, approve first, then generate. The Colab voice needs your audio upload. The finished video stays available for download, and each language is made separately.
